title: T.S. of blastula
back: Trophoblast (outer), inner cell mass (embryo, stem cells), blastocoel (cavity).

title: Wind vs insect vs bird flowers
tex: \begin{gathered}\text{wind: dull, light pollen}\\\text{insect: bright, scent, nectar}\\\text{bird: bright, much nectar}\end{gathered}

title: Spot: T.S. of testis
back: Spermatogonia at the wall, sperms in the lumen; Sertoli cells inside tubules.

title: Spot: T.S. of ovary
back: Tertiary follicles show an antrum; stroma surrounds the follicles.

title: Metaphase I vs anaphase I
tex: \begin{gathered}\text{M I: bivalents at equator}\\\text{A I: homologues to poles}\end{gathered}
back: In anaphase II, sister chromatids separate instead.

title: Controlled pollination
back: The tag records parents and date.

title: Ratios for the seed spot
back: Compare your seed counts with these.

title: Reading a pedigree
back: Every generation: often dominant. Mostly males via carrier mothers: X-linked recessive.

title: Lichen, nodule, Cuscuta
back: Cuscuta is leafless and yellow, feeding through haustoria.

title: Homologous vs analogous
tex: \begin{gathered}\text{same structure, diff. use}\\\text{diff. structure, same use}\end{gathered}
back: Forelimbs of whale, bat, human (homologous); wings of butterfly and bird (analogous).

title: Dull, Dry, Dusty
back: No colour or scent, no nectar, masses of light pollen.
